# Recommended Extensions for Visual Studio Code

To install all recommended extensions for this project, follow these steps:

1. Open the project in Visual Studio Code.
2. If prompted, click on "Install All" in the notification for recommended extensions.
3. Alternatively, you can install them manually using the following command for each extension:

   ```bash
   code --install-extension <extension-id>
   ```

   Example:
   ```bash
   code --install-extension ms-vscode.vscode-typescript-tslint-plugin
   ```

4. Ensure all extensions are installed to improve your development experience.
